text: Sorry, this might be nothing and I'm probably overthinking it because I've been up since 5, but I'm a childminder and I've got a 12 month old girl staying over tonight while her mum works a night shift. Her temp was 39.8 about twenty minutes ago, I think I did it right, under the arm. The bit that's bothering me, and I'm not sure if I'm reading too much into it, is that she's really not herself. She's sort of floppy when I pick her up, like she's just hanging there, and when I tried to wake her for some milk she barely opened her eyes and went straight back off. Normally she'd be grizzling or reaching for me but she's just not reacting much at all. I've looked after her loads and she's usually such a wriggler. I don't know if that's just the temperature making her tired or whether I should be doing something more. I've texted her mum but she can't answer on shift. I really don't want to overreact but I also don't want to sit here and get it wrong.
